ErrorSeverity.description: How bad an error is for the user, manufacturer neutral.

MowerErrorCategory.description:
What kind of fault ``MowerState.error_code`` names, manufacturer neutral.

The same words classify the entries of an error lexicon (ADR 0067), so rules such as the
theft alarm can match a category instead of vendor codes.
MowerErrorCategory.title: MowerErrorCategory

description:
Browse one lexicon (``gateway.errors.entries``): a page of its entries, explained in
``locale``, filtered by text, category, severity and codes (all optional, combined with and).

The lexicon is picked like for :class:`ErrorExplainRequest`: by ``vendor``, else by
``connection``.

codes.description: Only these codes (as the lexicon or the mower spells them); empty: all.
codes.title: Codes

query.description: Matches the code, its aliases and the texts in `locale` and English (case insensitive, every word must match); empty: everything.
query.title: Query
